name: Cursor Projects
desc: A container for a large body of work, with context across months.
desc_zh: 装下一大块工作、能在几个月里保持上下文的容器。
solves: An agent session forgets everything when it closes; a project holds the context and delegates pieces to many subagents.
solves_zh: 智能体会话一关就忘光；项目把上下文留住，再把片段分给许多子智能体。
best_for: You are migrating a monolith and the work will span weeks of agent sessions.
best_for_zh: 在拆一个单体应用，活儿要横跨好几周的智能体会话。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Projects」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/projects
